title: transcript verdict
description: One subagent's judgement on a single transcript session. Use as the `schema` of a workflow/`agent()` call so a fan-out of excerpt readers returns validated, aggregatable verdicts instead of prose that has to be re-parsed.

session_id.description: The sessions.id the excerpt was read from.

verdict.description: ISSUE: the session hit a concrete problem in the subject area. NO_ISSUE: it only mentioned the subject. UNCERTAIN: the excerpt is too truncated to judge.

severity.description: high = blocker/root-cause failure; medium = error but worked around; low = minor/notice; n/a when verdict is NO_ISSUE.

summary.description: One-sentence finding, with the concrete evidence (error text, command, symptom).

evidence.description: Optional quote of the specific message/command that supports the verdict.
